summary: No Blocker. Security review of phase_base 562c5800..audited_head 787e846d (HEAD confirmed current at 787e846d3afbc5e945b7d51eac28406a87833f15). Applicable: the diff changes the paid-provider spend guard. RB-1, RB-2, RB-3 and RA2-1 are closed by code read and pure-function probes (empty HOME, no provider call, no real out/ folder). One Major remains: the per-call re-check in the pool reads only logged spend, and a call is logged after it returns, so up to 4 workers (and up to 3 parallel line tries per worker) pass the same re-check together; the margin is 0.01 USD per call and the pool never reserves spend, so an overshoot beyond the cap is bounded only by in-flight calls times the real call cost. At the observed 0.01 USD per call the first-level projection still holds the sum under the cap; the hole opens when a call costs more than the margin. Nits: RB-4 (negative cost cell and headerless file undercount) and RB-5, RB-6 carry over; two new Nits cover a symlinked week folder and a paid call that is not logged when post-processing throws. Secret scan clean. Vitest not run by Review B: heavy lock held by other projects; Green gate evidence is jr-green-5bdf307.log (Test Files 6 passed, Tests 71 passed).
nonblocking_findings: RB2-1 [Major] review-b: The pool re-check cannot see calls in flight. scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:412-419 runs runGuards before each provider call, but logCall (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:225 for color, :255 and :265 for line) writes costs.tsv only after the call returns, and pool (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:361-374) starts 4 workers at once. Rationale: workers 1 to 4 read the same recorded spend and all pass; a line pool with --tries 3 starts up to 12 parallel calls (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:250-282) after one re-check of spend + 3 x 0.01. The projection uses the margin 0.01 USD as the price of a call (scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:301-303). Real calls cost 0.01 USD in w01/muse/costs.tsv, so the sum stays under the cap today, but a call that costs 0.02 to 0.03 USD, or a late-logged cost, lets the run pass 1.60 USD by (in-flight calls x real cost) instead of one batch step. Owner order is 'stop at 1.60 USD'. Disposition: FIX for Green (hold an in-memory reservation of margin x calls per worker before the call and release it after logCall, or run the pool with concurrency 1 near the cap). Static finding; not run with a mock fetch because the shell rejected the scratch mock file.

RB2-2 [Nit] review-b: A symlinked week folder escapes the restart scan. scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:212-213 skips entries where e.isDirectory() is false, and a symlink to a folder is not a directory entry, while classifyOutDir (scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:82-91) resolves lexically and returns 'restart'. Rationale: probe in scratch: unit1/w10 -> /tmp/opencode/rb2/outside with a 5 USD cost row gave kind=restart, scan rows 0, runGuards refused=false, spend=0. The precondition is a symlink under out/, made by someone with local access, so the severity is Nit. Disposition: note; use realpathSync in classifyOutDir and refuse a path whose real path leaves the unit root.

RB2-3 [Nit] review-b: A paid call is not logged when post-processing throws. In doColor (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:220-225) sharp(r.buf) and writeFileSafe run before logCall; in doLine (:259-265) the same order holds. Rationale: a bad image body or a 'refused to overwrite' error (for example the same spec listed twice, where both workers read the same nextVersion at :211) loses r.cost, so the guard undercounts. Also, a timed-out call is logged with cost 0 (:91) and does not count as a try (guards :175), although the provider may bill it. Disposition: note; log the cost first, then write files.

RB2-4 [Nit] review-b: Pre-fix classification gap on a case-insensitive file system: 'Cards/muse' is classified restart (probe: kind=restart) while the restart scan skips only the exact name 'cards'. Rationale: on Linux this is a separate folder and is scanned; on macOS it maps to the card folder and the restart cap would not see it. The machine is Linux, so Nit. Disposition: note.

RB-4 [Nit] review-b: parseCostsTsv keeps a negative cost cell (scripts/storytime-muse-guards.mjs:164 Number(x) || 0), a headerless file gives cost 0 for every row (no 'usage_cost' column found, line 152-153), and sinceStart drops a row whose time does not parse (line 171-172), so a corrupted or hand-edited costs.tsv undercounts spend. Rationale: unchanged since round 1; the tool writes its own header and rows, so the risk needs a manual edit. Disposition: note (clamp negatives to 0; fail closed when the cost column is missing). Not re-run by probe: the shell rejected the probe command; the finding rests on the code read.

RB-5 [Nit] review-b: spec.references, import --color and --line have no containment check (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:77, 336-346). Rationale: unchanged; outDir is now contained by classifyOutDir, and the 31 card specs are pinned by CS4, CS6 and CS9. Disposition: note.

RB-6 [Nit] review-b: readKey accepts the misspelled OPERNROUTER_API_KEY fallback (scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:42). Rationale: pre-existing, harmless, can mask an env file that holds only the typo name. Disposition: note.

RB2-5 [Nit] review-b: Stale text in spec.md:214-215 says the RA2-1 fix is 'pending in the next Green round', but 91b2a1ca closed it. Also scratch-side effect: loadSpec calls mkdirSync(dir, recursive) at scripts/storytime-muse.mjs:56 before the guard, so a refused invalid outDir still creates an empty folder. Rationale: documentation drift and an empty folder; no spend. Disposition: note.

RB-2 closed: classifyOutDir (guards :80-94) resolves against ROOT and unit root. Pure-function probe (scratch /tmp/opencode/rb2/repo, empty HOME): cards/muse and cards/muse/ -> card; cards/muse2 and Cards variants of other folders -> invalid or restart as expected; w01/muse/../../cards/muse -> card; w01/muse/../../cards/muse/elements -> invalid; w01/muse/elements/x -> invalid; unit1, unit1/muse, w01/muse2, w01/Muse, w01/muse/../../../unit2/w01/muse -> invalid; no outDir and undefined spec -> restart (w01 default); outDir '' -> invalid (resolves to ROOT, same as loadSpec). runGuards refuses invalid specs with exit code 3 before any cost scan (guards :261-273); CLI calls runGuards at storytime-muse.mjs:404 before readKey at :411. CG13 (:218-268) covers the CLI path.

RB-3 partly closed: the batch projection (guards :299-306) refuses spend + (calls + cushion) x 0.01 over the cap; CG14 (:270-305) pins the boundary (1.50 with 10 specs refused, 9 allowed; 1.56 with 2 specs x 2 tries allowed, 1.57 refused; single call at 1.58 allowed, 1.595 refused). The per-call re-check exists (storytime-muse.mjs:414-418) and a refusal skips the call. Open part: RB2-1, the re-check reads logged spend only.

RA2-1 closed: guards :89 returns invalid for any path below the child 'cards' other than the exact card folder (probe: cards/muse/elements -> invalid; cards/other/muse and cards/muse2 covered by CG15 :307-352). Mixed card and non-card calls are refused before any scan (guards :274-285).

Line --tries: requested tries multiply the call count in the projection (guards :300-303) and in tryGuard (:187-192); non-integer or NaN --tries cannot exceed the cap of 3 (ceil(x) <= limit - count when count + x <= limit); NaN gives zero reserved tries at storytime-muse.mjs:246. --concurrency NaN, 0 or negative gives zero workers (Math.min(4, NaN) = NaN), a safe direction.
Observed call cost: out/storytime/l2/unit1/w01/muse/costs.tsv rows show usage_cost 0.01 per call, equal to the 0.01 margin; out/storytime/l2/unit1/cards/ does not exist, so no card call has run.

Key handling: readKey (storytime-muse.mjs:35-46) runs only after a passed guard; the key goes into the Authorization header (:88) only; no print, log, or write of the key in the code or tests (CG10 uses a temp HOME with no env file). The Workbooks env file was not opened by Review B.
